page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a centred closing block and a title block above the letter's body. No margin notes. Running head top left, page number top right. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: motissimi cùm simus, dare operam debe-
mus, ut non errores modo, verùm eti-
quibus ad novos errores via sternitur,
tuis, amicissime Morine, hæc pauca de-
ponere, & qvale sit etiam judicium tu-
suum de Critica Sacra Capelli, & in
eum Anima versiones, cur Parisiis cum
bationibus, quid in ea laude dignum,
quid vituperio, quis sit sensus Concilii
ad me literis testetur, tantopere sibi

page.notes: No printed notes in the margins. Doubtful readings: "tutis" in "Liceat mihi tutis auribus" (the word may be "tuis"). The first word of the page, "motissimi", has a long s, which is written as s; the printed form may differ. The opening "C" of "CUm" is a large initial, transcribed as printed. The running head is taken as printed in capitals. The stray mark at the top left corner is not text and is left out.
